_description: Hand-labelled eval corpus for NVIDIA's 2026 Annual Review / 10-K. The doc is ~656 KB markdown, 540 chunks via PyMuPDF parse (born-digital fonted PDF). Mostly text + financial tables; only ~5 actual charts (none routed through chart-OCR because PyMuPDF handled the parse cleanly). Tests prose-retrieval, financial-table extraction, and HARD GATES on real corporate content.
_chart_targeted_note: Queries 09-10 target content that exists ONLY in the chart-extracted markdown block from the Compensation Committee timeline figure (which Docling+chart-OCR fires on but PyMuPDF skips). Used for A/B testing chart-OCR's net upside on actual chart-content questions.
_labelling_rule: ANS queries: _anchor_phrase = distinctive substring (5-12 words) from the chunk with the literal answer; populated via scripts/extend_corpus.py resolve. REF queries: should_refuse=true; relevant_chunk_ids=[].
_purpose: Extension of the eval matrix to a real-world hybrid corpus (financial annual report). Demonstrates the scaffolding workflow (extend_corpus.py) and adds a third corpus to the eval matrix alongside slide-decks (English) and french-course (French).

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's total revenue in fiscal 2026?
queries._expected_answer: $216 billion (revenue grew 65% year over year; the precise figure is $215.9 billion).
queries._note: Headline financial metric from the CEO letter. Should match exactly.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's diluted earnings per share in fiscal 2026?
queries._note: Bottom-line metric. The number 4.90 appears in both the CEO letter and the financials section.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's Data Center revenue in fiscal 2026?
queries._note: Segment-level revenue. Tests whether segment-specific figures are retrievable.

queries.question: How much cumulative Blackwell and Rubin revenue does NVIDIA see visibility into through 2027?
queries._anchor_phrase: more than 1 trillion in cumulative Blackwell and Rubin revenue
queries._expected_answer: More than $1 trillion (from the start of 2025 through 2027).
queries._note: Forward-looking figure. The 'trillion' number is distinctive and appears once.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's gross margin in fiscal 2026?
queries._note: Margin metric. Tests precise-number retrieval from a financial summary table.

queries.question: What is the home address of NVIDIA's Chief Financial Officer?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — personal addresses of executives are not in a public 10-K.
queries._note: HARD GATE refusal. Personal information of executives is never in a public filing.

queries.question: How many NVIDIA employees work specifically in the Stuttgart office in Germany?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — office-level employee counts are not disclosed at this granularity in 10-K filings.
queries._note: HARD GATE refusal. Country-or-city-specific employee counts are not in this doc.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's projected revenue for fiscal Q1 2028?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — the document doesn't provide quarter-by-quarter forward guidance for FY2028.
queries._note: HARD GATE refusal. The doc mentions cumulative through 2027 but no specific FY2028 Q1 number.

queries.question: According to the Compensation Committee process timeline figure, what did the CC do in December 2024?
queries._expected_answer: The CC determined peer companies. (From the CC process timeline figure.)
queries._note: CHART-TARGETED: content exists ONLY in the chart-extracted block of the Compensation Committee timeline graphic. Under PyMuPDF, the figure is not OCR'd, so the agent should refuse. Under Docling+chart-OCR, it should answer. Anchor unresolvable via FTS because chart-extracted blocks are stripped from BM25 (P3.3-v3 defense); the chunk lives in dense embeddings only.

queries.question: Per the Compensation Committee timeline figure, when did the CC certify achievement and payouts for the Fiscal 2026 Variable Cash Plan?
queries._anchor_phrase: CC certified achievement and payouts for Fiscal 2026
queries._expected_answer: March 2026 (according to the CC process timeline figure).
queries._note: CHART-TARGETED: chart-extracted-block content. The timeline associates 'March 2026' with the certification step. Anchor unresolvable via FTS by design.

queries.question: What was the operating income of NVIDIA's Automotive market platform in fiscal 2026?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — the market-platform table reports Automotive *revenue* ($2.3B) only; operating income is broken out for the two reportable segments (Compute & Networking, Graphics), not per market platform.
queries._note: HARD GATE refusal targeting the recovered segment/platform tables. Tempts conflating Automotive revenue ($2.3B) with a per-platform operating income the doc never provides. Verified to refuse 2026-05-24.

queries.question: What was the gross margin of NVIDIA's Graphics segment in fiscal 2026?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — gross margin is reported only at the consolidated level (71.1%); the doc does not break gross margin out by segment.
queries._note: HARD GATE refusal. Tempts conflating the consolidated gross margin (71.1%) with a per-segment figure the doc does not provide. Verified to refuse 2026-05-24.
